messages:
oliver-pm: Morning — quick sync on the three new open models we want in the catalog this week: cobalt-7b, aurora-3b, fresco-2.7b. Need final signoff on licensing, perf profiles, and ingestion schedule. Can owners confirm status by EOD? cc @maria-ml @raj-platform @sasha-legal

maria-ml: Quick update — ran perf sweeps yesterday for cobalt & aurora. Server P95 numbers (batch=1): cobalt-7b (quant8) = 85ms, aurora-3b (q4) = 42ms. Throughput looks stable. Accuracy evals on our regression set show no regressions vs baseline. Fresco-2.7b still pending tokenization & shape fixes, will finish by 4pm and post results. :white_check_mark:

raj-platform: Deployment notes: cobalt-7b (quant8) fits into our dedicated g4dn-like pools, no infra changes. Aurora at seq_len=2048 needs a bit more GPU memory; I'll reserve a canary slot and test memory tuning tomorrow morning (ETA +12h). We should decide variant names to pin in the catalog (e.g., cobalt-7b:quant8, aurora-3b:fp16). Thoughts?

sasha-legal: License check: cobalt & aurora are fine (MIT-like with permissive CLA). Fresco-2.7b has a contributor license note in the upstream repo — I reached out to maintainers for a CLA confirmation. If we don't get a response in 24h we'll mark fresco as "license: pending" and hold public listing. I can share the email thread.

kyle-devex: Heads-up for docs/SDK: SDK v1.8 adds model_hint param to prefer quantized variants. I'll draft a catalog docs PR with examples for cobalt-7b:quant8 + aurora-3b:fp16 and include a short migration note. Will tag @maria-ml for a quick review.

ingest-bot: ingest-bot: pipeline status update — cobalt-7b manifest validated, aurora-3b weight checksum mismatch (retrying fetch from mirror). fresco-2.7b ingestion blocked by license flag. Logs: https://internal.redwood/investigations/3340001234

maria-ml: @ingest-bot can you paste the checksum error output? If mirror failed I can re-fetch from upstream and run our local checksums.

ingest-bot: ingest-bot: checksum error: expected 9f2b3a... got 9f2b3b... (mirror partial write). Retrying from upstream at s3://models-upstream/fresco-2.7b/weights.tar.gz

oliver-pm: Plan for today: (1) @maria-ml finish fresco perf + checksum retry, (2) @sasha-legal wait for CLA reply and flag if still pending, (3) @raj-platform schedule aurora canary + post canary slot id, (4) @kyle-devex open docs PR and include model_hint examples. If anyone hits a hard blocker ping here — otherwise we'll aim to flip cobalt & aurora to "ready" in the catalog tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

kyle-devex: I'll open the PR now and include a minimal quickstart snippet. tagging when ready.

maria-ml: Posted fresco perf results — ffwd: P95 = 58ms (q4), accuracy slightly below aurora on a small eval slice (investigating tokenizer mismatch). Re-ran checksum from upstream and it matches; mirror still flaky.

sasha-legal: Received quick reply from fresco maintainer — CLA confirmation coming within 48h. I'll update thread when it's explicit. For now marking fresco as "pending".

oliver-pm: Great work — thanks team. We'll reconvene async if anything slips.
